name: Easy Sheet Pan Cheeseburgers with Lettuce, Tomato, Special Sauce & Sweet Potato Fries

ingredients.name: julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).

When the oven is heated, transfer fries to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy, about 25 minutes. (Or cook according to package instructions.) Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (20 oz) bag julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place in a medium bowl along with beef, Worcestershire, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the ground beef mixture to another baking sheet and pat into a ¾-inch thick square using your hands. Score the square with a knife (don't cut all the way through), creating 4 "burger patties."
Add baking sheet to the oven and bake until the beef is golden and cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, carefully drain cooking juices, and set aside.
While the burgers are cooking, wash, dry, and slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.
Wash, dry, and separate lettuce into leaves. Add to the plate with the tomatoes and set aside.
Place dressing and mayo in a small bowl, then stir to combine the special sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Thousand Island dressing
2 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: When the fries are done, change the oven to broil on high.
Top each burger with a slice of cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut burgers apart along the scored lines.

Split buns. Spread the bottom half of each bun with special sauce, then top with cheesy patties, lettuce, and tomato. Close with the top half of each bun. Divide burgers and sweet potato fries between plates. Enjoy!
